title: Movement: variant ships next to their base ship
description: A system held one carrier and one sol_carrier. The movement dialog counted ships by base type, so the Sol Carrier row said Available: 2 and its + stayed enabled after the first click; the engine offers one move per distinct unit type, so the second staged move was not offered and the whole batch was rejected (409 option unavailable). Now each row counts only units of its exact type: Available: 1, + disabled after one click, and the Carrier row is untouched. The same holds for carrier2, destroyer2, cruiser2, dreadnought2 and faction ships. Before shots are taken on the commit without the fix; after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- BU.

shots.heading: Before: one Sol Carrier staged, desktop
shots.caption: The Sol Carrier row reads Available: 2 and + is still enabled although only one sol_carrier is there.

shots.heading: After: one Sol Carrier staged, desktop
shots.caption: Available: 1, count 1, + disabled; the plain Carrier row still offers its own ship.

shots.heading: Before: one Sol Carrier staged, 390x844
shots.caption: Same wrong count on a phone.

notes.title: Why exact type
notes.text: tactical::movement_options deduplicates on (type id, damage, origin, Gravity Drive, Ionian), so each type is its own option and a plain carrier is not interchangeable with a sol_carrier. Counts now come from board units of that exact type; hit assignment already groups by exact type, and the base-type counts in the remove-unit and combat panels are display summaries only.
